- We want to run a customer-led load test next week to validate the Dedicated config you've proposed.

Could your team share suggested k6/Locust scenarios (ramp, steady state, checkers for token latency), test account details and an IP allowlist so we can kick off from our infra? Also prefer a 2-hour test window in PST mornings (8–10am) if that helps.

Thanks — Zoe

Kimberly / Zoe — attaching two lightweight artifacts to get the run started and a short checklist. Notes inline below.

Attachments (stubs):
- sprintflow_k6_v1.js (k6 script — includes ramp/steady/teardown stages and checks for request latency and token stream latency markers)
- locustfile_sprintflow.py (Locust for streaming/hybrid load with custom websocket client shim)
- sprintflow-preflight-runbook.pdf (preflight checklist + rollback steps + telemetry knobs)

High level recommendations for the run:
- Ramp: 0 -> 120 req/s over 12 minutes, hold 60 minutes, then ramp down over 8 minutes. That gives a long enough steady state to get percentile stability.
- Streaming: spin up streaming sessions to reach 60 concurrent sessions. Each session should stream ~300 tokens across ~6 chunks to approximate your average.
- Concurrency: constrain per-VIP connections to mimic real client fanout; our k6 script parameterizes connection_count and token_size.
- Validations to include in scripts: p50/p95/p99 for request latency, p90 for streaming token latency (we instrument the stream to emit token-timings), and an end-to-end success rate target >= 99.5%.
- Failure signals: sustained p95 > 1.5x target for 10 minutes, error rate > 1% — treat as red and trigger immediate rollback.

Test accounts/creds: we'll issue scoped API keys that only hit your Dedicated pool and expire at test end. Please confirm which engineers need keys and their emails.

IP allowlist: if you provide CIDR ranges we will add them to the cluster allowlist; if SprintFlow cannot egress from stable IPs, we can give a VPN endpoint for the run.

Let us know preferred windows and we can reserve capacity on the Dedicated pool and schedule an on-call SE.

- Aditya
